Goal! Mainz 0, Bayer 04 Leverkusen 1. Robert Andrich (Bayer 04 Leverkusen) right footed shot from outside the box to the high centre of the goal.
Goal! Mainz 0, Bayer 04 Leverkusen 2. Patrik Schick (Bayer 04 Leverkusen) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Aleix García.
Phillip Tietz (Mainz) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Miguel Gutiérrez (Bayer 04 Leverkusen).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Mainz 1, Bayer 04 Leverkusen 2. Anthony Caci (Mainz) right footed shot from very close range to the top left corner following a corner.
Sheraldo Becker (Mainz) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Mainz 2, Bayer 04 Leverkusen 2. Anthony Caci (Mainz) left footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Nadiem Amiri.
